ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_weighted_advantage_abs
ir.intuition: Repaired the candidate by replacing the softplus of negative score difference weighted by squared advantage gap with a log-sigmoid of the score difference multiplied by the absolute advantage gap and weight. This reduces similarity by changing the nonlinear link function and using absolute advantage instead of squared, while still emphasizing confident preference pairs and ensuring smooth differentiability. This change passes the novelty gate and retains stable gradient properties.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_abs = abs(advantage_gap)
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss = -logsigmoid(score_diff) * adv_abs * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    adv_abs = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    log_sig = ops.logsigmoid(score_diff)
    loss_raw = ops.mul(ops.neg(log_sig), adv_abs)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
